import pandas as pd

# Extract the starting year from "years for jazz" (e.g., "2007", "1996 - 99")
start_years = df["years for jazz"].str.extract(r"(\d{4})")[0].astype(int)

# US players who started after 1985
us_after = df[(df["nationality"].str.strip().str.lower() == "united states") & (start_years > 1985)]

count_ok = len(us_after) == 4

# Check the most recent (latest start year) is louis amundson
us_after = us_after.assign(start=start_years[us_after.index])
most_recent = us_after.loc[us_after["start"].idxmax(), "player"].strip().lower()
recent_ok = most_recent == "louis amundson"

answer = bool(count_ok and recent_ok)
